title: Enumerate, Chain, Keys and Values
hints: All four are adapters with the same skeleton: `return func(yield …) { for … := range seq { if !yield(…) { return } } }`. Only what you range over and what you yield change.

`Enumerate`: `i := 0` before the loop, `yield(i, v)`, then `i++`. `Keys`: `for k := range seq` (a one-variable range over a `Seq2` gives the first value). `Values`: `for _, v := range seq`. `Chain`: `for _, seq := range seqs`, skip `nil`, then range over `seq`.
